definition.method: Simulate an inquiry accuracy trajectory and observe calculated abandonment decision triggers.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    params = inputs.get('parameters', {})
    threshold = params.get('threshold', 0.3)
    trials = [random.random() for _ in range(10)]
    abandonments = [1 if t < threshold else 0 for t in trials]
    return {'measurements': {'abandonment_rate': [sum(abandonments) / len(abandonments)]}}
definition.stop: Completion of 10 trial evaluations across 3 random seeds.
